snippet.title: Office Manager - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4169060/Office_Manager/
Build, manage, and expand your very own corporate empire! 🏢 Welcome to the official Announcement Trailer for Office Manager. 

Play the FREE DEMO this June and get ready for the Early Access launch in Q4 2026! 🚀
Don't forget to add the game to your Steam Wishlist to support a solo indie developer! 

WISHLIST ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4169060/Office_Manager/

A huge thank you to our amazing partners:
